I've built a wrist fracture codelist from 191 codes found in the knowledge store. It covers fractures of the lower end of the radius and/or ulna, fractures of the carpal bones, and wrist fracture-dislocations and fracture-subluxations, both closed and open.

- **Broad codes kept:** S242 and Syu65 ("Fracture at wrist and hand level") are kept even though they also cover hand fractures.
- **Galeazzi fractures kept:** S2348 and S2358 are kept because they sit under "lower end of forearm" in the hierarchy. Strictly, though, they are fractures of the radial shaft near the wrist.
- **Carpometacarpal joint fracture-dislocations kept:** S4C03, S4C13, S4C23 and S4C33 are kept, but they are on the edge of what counts as the wrist.
